**1 — Scene:** A breakfast tray with a toasted muffin-and-cheese sandwich, avocado, a fried egg, orange juice, and coffee. The egg’s fully visible side plate appears to belong to this same tray, so I include it.

**2 — Vessels:** Main plate approximately **24 cm** diameter: area **452 cm²**. Egg plate approximately **20 cm**: area **314 cm²**. The drinks are estimated separately from their visible fill levels.

**3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy:**

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × average height = volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Toasted English muffin | 17% of main plate | 77 cm² × 2 cm = 154 ml | 0.45 | 69 | 250 |
| Melted cheese | Within muffin footprint | 65 cm² × 0.23 cm = 15 ml | 1.0 | 15 | 400 |
| Avocado slices | 9% of main plate | 41 cm² × 1.4 cm = 57 ml | 0.65 | 37 | 160 |
| Fried egg | 22% of egg plate | 69 cm² × 0.75 cm = 52 ml | 1.0 | 52 | 190 |
| Orange juice | Glass | Approximately 150 ml | 1.04 | 156 | 45 |
| Coffee, apparently with milk | Mug | Approximately 200 ml | 1.0 | 200 | 30 |

The main plate is approximately **26% covered**; the cheese overlaps the muffin and is not added again to coverage. The egg covers approximately **22%** of its plate. The fried-egg energy estimate includes a small amount of cooking fat; no separate oil or sauce is clearly visible. Coffee composition is uncertain.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **173 g of solid food**, plus **356 g of drinks**, is plausible for these modest portions and largely uncovered plates. Estimated total: **529 g and 520 kcal**, with the greatest uncertainty in the sandwich and coffee.
